description: Text that pops in one word at a time instead of fading in as a single block — for beats, emphasis, or narration-synced callouts. Word stagger auto-compresses to always resolve before the asset's exit, even with long copy.

staggerFrames.description: target frames between word starts; auto-shrunk to fit the timing budget

wordPopScale.description: overshoot scale each word pops past on the way in
